time.Say: To arms! Intruders at the gate!
To arms! Intruders at the gate!

Options.Say: We’re the troupe for tonight’s feast.

Success.Say: Through to the hall, then. Don’t dawdle.

Options.Say: He burned Ashford. Your own village. You know what he is.

Success.Say: …Gods forgive me. The garrison is yours. We take the keep.

Failure.Say: Lies. Get out before I change my mind.

Options.Say: Hold the gate. Let no one in or out until it’s done.

Success.Say: Feast for the whole court, and him sitting there grinning after what he did to Ashford.

Options.Say: What did he do to Ashford?

Success.Say: Burned it. Every house. The captain’s mother was in one.

Options.Say: Ten gold says you never saw us.
